versions.changelog: v1.0.1: fix --overwrite-existing end-to-end gap; emit stderr warning when overwriting existing GPS; spec amendment for non-JPG handling; minor cleanups

- Initial release of geo-tag-photos: recover lost GPS metadata for JPG photos by visually identifying landmarks and writing GPS coordinates to EXIF.
- Five-phase workflow: scan for missing GPS, recognize landmarks, geocode locations, generate report, and safely write EXIF metadata (requires explicit confirmation and backup).
- Supports batch processing of hundreds of JPGs with global coverage using Nominatim (OpenStreetMap).
- Strict privacy: only landmark, city, and country text sent to geocoding service; photos never uploaded by the script.
- Hard limits and safety checks enforced to prevent accidental overwrites, non-JPG processing, or incomplete backups.
